name: Phone Number Information
description: Offline phone-number normalization, numbering-plan geography and original carrier lookup.
requirements: phonenumbers >=9.0,<10.0, included in the minimal and all installation extras
The existing phone-number MISP object template
features: Use libphonenumber metadata locally. No API credentials, network requests, calls or SMS messages are required.
Normalize valid numbers to E.164 and report the calling code, inferred region, number type, numbering-plan area, original carrier and possible time zones.
Preserve the original attribute, UUID, tags, comment and detection flag. The returned phone-number object references the original attribute with derived-from.
Preserve extensions in the summary rather than appending them to the E.164 number. All newly generated attributes use to_ids=false. Descriptive text attributes disable correlation.

Location describes numbering-plan allocation, not the subscriber's current physical location. Number portability can change the current operator; carrier results describe original allocation when applicable.

Validity means the number matches the library's numbering-plan metadata. It does not establish assignment, reachability, ownership or maliciousness. Metadata may lag numbering-plan changes; the summary records the installed library version.
Shared calling codes are interpreted using the full number. Non-geographic calling codes do not produce a country-code attribute. Missing geographic, carrier or time-zone metadata is labeled Unknown.

Parseable but invalid numbers return the original attribute plus a text diagnostic showing possible and valid status, without creating a normalized phone-number object. Malformed or ambiguous input returns an error. Short codes are outside this module's scope.

input.value: A nonempty phone-number string. Use a leading + for an international number, or set default_region for national numbers and international dialling prefixes. The module never guesses a default region.

output.response: results.Attribute retains the queried attribute. results.Object contains one phone-number object for valid numbers, or is empty for invalid numbers; the latter add a non-correlating text diagnostic to results.Attribute.

object_relations.phone-number: Normalized E.164 number without an extension
object_relations.country-code: Numbering-plan region when geographic; the non-geographic pseudo-region 001 is omitted
object_relations.text: One labeled summary containing original input, possible/valid status, number type, numbering-plan area, original carrier, possible time zones, extension, library version and interpretation limits

default_region.description: Supported two-letter origin region, such as GB, FR or US. Required for national-format input and international dialling prefixes such as 00, whose interpretation depends on the origin region. Case-insensitive. Leave empty when all inputs begin with +.

language.description: Language code for geographic and carrier descriptions, such as en, fr or de. Missing translations remain Unknown. Number formatting does not depend on this setting.

examples.description: Normalize an international fixed-line number and identify its numbering-plan area.
Interpret a national-format WHOIS phone number using an explicit origin region.
